method: OpenSEO keyword-research and competitor-analysis workflows applied to public search results. These are page-level observations, not provider rankings, traffic estimates or keyword-volume measurements.
queries: best baby feeding tracker app formula breastfeeding pumping growth tracker 2026
baby vitamin D tracker app formula vitamin D remaining supplement
baby feeding app with WHO growth charts allergen tracking medicine vaccine tracker
baby feeding tracker keyword formula tracker breastfeeding app pumping app WHO growth percentile tracker parents search
mom influencer affiliate program baby app IBCLC ambassador
observations: The category-results pages compete through broad all-in-one positioning, free-tier explanations, prediction features and doctor-ready reports.

Formula-by-name, vitamin tracking, allergen records, WHO growth and pediatrician reports are distinct product stories in competitor content, supporting dedicated page intents rather than one generic app page.
The existing public Feed Flow result was still the older feeding-only page at research time, so the new local build substantially expands owned-page coverage; it has not been deployed in this task.

Competitor superlatives and unverified clinical or market-leadership claims should not be copied. Feed Flow can differentiate with real screens, a lock-screen countdown, FlowCast notifications, exact vitamin D arithmetic and private iCloud reports.
